entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
-----
 Ms. Neha Balani, Tahir Hussain, Pratiksha More i/by Hulyalkar &
 Associates for the Applicants.
 Mr. B. V. Holambe Patil, App for the Respondent-State.

-----
 Coram : N.R. Borkar, J.
 Date : 06Th March 2026
 P.C. :
 1.
This is an Application for transit anticipatory bail.

2. The Applicants are apprehending their arrest in Crime No.92
 2019 registered with Pali Police Station, Jahanabad District, State 
 for the offences punishable under Sections 114, 406, 420, 465, 467, 
471, 506, 120B of the Indian Penal Code.
3.  It is the case of the prosecution that the first informant   Applicant Alfiya Shaikh got acquainted with each other due to simila  occupational background in electronic media and film industry.

It is  alleged that subsequently they started a partnership firm namely M/s  Digital and as such acquired a well paying contracts from Hungama  Digital Media Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. as well as owned YouTube chann  that generated a good revenue.

entities.text: Hungama  Digital Media Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. I have heard Learned Counsel for the Applicants and Learned  Counsel for the Respondent-State.
 5.

Learned Counsel for the Applicants submits that similar complaint  was filed by the first informant before the Metropolitan Magistrate, 44 th  Court, Andheri, Mumbai and by the order dated 06 th July 2019, the prayer  made by the first informant for ordering investigation under Section 156  (3) of the Cr.P.C.was rejected.

entities.text: Metropolitan Magistrate, 44 th  Court, Andheri, Mumbai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that with ulterior motive, the  first informant had filed the similar complaint before the Chief Judicial  Magistrate at Jahanabad pursuant to which the crime in question came to  be registered.
It is submitted that to enable the Applicants to approach the  jurisdictional court, they may be protected for a period of twelve weeks.
6. Considering the overall facts and circumstances, I am inclined to  protect the Applicants from arrest for a period of six weeks.

Hence, the  following order is passed :-
 ORDER i.

ii. In the event of the arrest of the Applicants in Crime No.92 of 2019 registered with Pali Police Station, Jahanabad District, State of Bihar for the offences punishable under Sections 114, 406, 420,
465, 467, 468, 471, 506, 120B of the Indian Penal Mugdha 2 of 3 3 920-ABA 580-26.doc Code, they shall be released on bail on furnishing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) each with one or two sureties in the like amount for a period of six weeks.
7. The Application is disposed of in the aforesaid terms.

(N.R. BORKAR, J.)
